recommended_rule.name: ew2|eb0.5c|mm5
recommended_rule.text: Monthly, on data before m: wallets with >=15 weighted prints and >=5 weighted matches in the 0-3 s post-onset bucket (month weight 0.5^((age-1)/2)); DerSimonian-Laird EB-shrunk mean 30 s markout minus expected fee (rate known at start of m x wallet mean p(1-p)) > 0.5c. Take their 0-3 s trades, <=$1k/trade, <=$3k/match, hold to resolution; no extra trade filters.
